coverage.method: Parent-shared snapshot, targeted offline overlap searches, local READMEs/TASK/ledger, and targeted live GraphQL head queries. No independent full refresh.
coverage.limitations: Open PR metadata includes drafts; closed/merged work is searched only through retained local packages and targeted known-head queries. Arbitrary diffs and all historical closed PRs are not exhausted. No matches is not a novelty certificate.
